image_description: A grey whale tail fluke (caudal fin) rising vertically out of calm, misty water. The background features hazy, blue-toned mountains or hills. The whale's body is submerged, with only the peduncle and flukes visible. The flukes are dark grey/black on the dorsal side and lighter/white on the ventral side, showing a distinct central notch.
